title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
summary: In this paper, we study physically grounded articulated 3D asset generation---moving the goal from reproducing how objects look to capturing how they move and function. Inspired by the literature on procedural and agentic generation, we present Artisan, a system that extends the latest method Articraft by introducing a multi-agent pipeline with physical simulation feedback, enabling comprehensive attributes beyond geometry, appearance, and physically plausible articulation, such as collision-free motion, stability under gravity, and accurate mass and material properties. Furthermore, we construct a unified benchmark spanning four key aspects: spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, downstream task performance, and overall quality. The benchmark encompasses 100 reference assets from ArtVIP and LightWheel, 50 stability prompts, and 50 ABO objects with reference masses, with protocols evaluating various metrics. Through extensive evaluation of more than 10 representative models, Artisan achieves competitive spatial fidelity while attaining the lowest collision rates and highest stability rates among the evaluated methods. Together, our system and benchmark establish insights for advancing 3D generation towards physically plausible, functionally usable assets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Artisan系统，利用多智能体管道和物理模拟反馈生成具有物理基础的铰接式3D资产，并构建了统一的评估基准。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D资产生成主要关注外观的复现，缺乏对物体运动和功能的捕获，如无碰撞运动、重力下的稳定性以及准确的质量和材料属性。
AI.method: 提出Artisan系统，在现有Articraft方法基础上引入结合物理模拟反馈的多智能体管道；此外，构建了一个涵盖空间保真度、物理合理性、下游任务表现和整体质量的统一基准。
AI.result: 对超过10个代表性模型的广泛评估表明，Artisan在保持具有竞争力的空间保真度的同时，实现了评估方法中最低的碰撞率和最高的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: Artisan系统和统一基准为推动3D生成向物理合理、功能可用的方向发展提供了重要见解。

title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.

AI.tldr: RSI-Anything是一个基于JEPA-Anything的领域通用框架，利用预测世界模型指导行动和学习数据选择，实现跨多样化环境的递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进(RSI)旨在将交互经验转化为持续改进，但外部反馈成本高昂，且随着策略演变，世界模型预测可能变得不可靠。
AI.method: 基于JEPA-Anything构建的框架，通过观察反馈驱动策略/工作流改进和条件世界模型适应，同时使用组件和兼容性检查来管理更新策略-模型对的保留。
AI.result: 在代码修复中，成功率从静态验证器的26.3%提高到世界模型适应后的31.2%；GUI评估中任务完成率更高，平均行动减少39.4%；实验室规划分数从21.80%翻倍到46.01%；反应优化实现96.15%平均最佳观测产率，优于贝叶斯优化的82.16%。
AI.conclusion: 预测世界模型和保留系统更新能够在不同环境中实现递归改进，包括计算、科学和免疫科学应用领域。

title: Information-Weighted Distributed Kalman Filter for Multi-Target Tracking over Switching Sensor Networks
summary: Target tracking over wide areas using a network of sensor agents is a challenging problem when agents have limited sensing coverage and communication topologies vary over time. Existing distributed filtering approaches commonly assume that each agent, or at least one of its neighbors, can directly observe the target, and further rely on fixed network topologies, global network parameters, or multiple consensus rounds per time step. These requirements limit their applicability in wide-area network deployments. In this paper, we propose an Information-Weighted Distributed Kalman Filter (IWDKF) that relaxes these assumptions through a weighted-consensus mechanism applicable to arbitrary switching topologies satisfying joint connectivity. The proposed approach requires no prior knowledge of global network properties and limits communication overhead to a single consensus exchange per time step, while enabling information fusion even when some agents lack direct target measurements. The weighted-consensus covariance matrix is shown to remain positive definite, and the resulting consensus update is proven to maintain estimate consistency. It is also established that the proposed weighting strategy preserves the asymptotic agreement property of the underlying consensus protocol under joint connectivity. Numerical simulations of a multi-target tracking scenario involving a network of sensor agents demonstrate the improved estimation accuracy of the proposed IWDKF under both fixed and switching network topologies. The performance of the proposed filter is close to that of the centralized Kalman filter, and is compared with three existing distributed filters.

AI.tldr: 提出一种信息加权分布式卡尔曼滤波器（IWDKF），通过加权一致性机制在任意切换拓扑下实现广域目标跟踪，且无需全局网络参数或多次一致性交换。
AI.motivation: 现有分布式滤波方法通常假设智能体能直接观测目标，并依赖固定拓扑、全局网络参数或多次一致性交换，这些限制条件降低了其在广域传感器网络中的适用性。
AI.method: 提出信息加权分布式卡尔曼滤波器（IWDKF），采用适用于满足联合连通性的任意切换拓扑的加权一致性机制。该方法无需全局网络先验知识，每时间步仅需单次一致性交换，并能在部分智能体缺乏直接目标测量时实现信息融合。
AI.result: 理论证明了加权一致性协方差矩阵的正定性、估计的一致性以及在联合连通性下的渐近一致性。多目标跟踪仿真表明，IWDKF在固定和切换拓扑下均提高了估计精度，其性能接近集中式卡尔曼滤波器，并优于三种现有分布式滤波器。
AI.conclusion: 所提IWDKF有效放宽了分布式滤波的严格假设，能够在通信受限和拓扑时变的广域网络中实现高精度、高一致性的目标跟踪。

title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
summary: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.

AI.tldr: 提出RATED框架，通过结合语义匹配和基于实时执行反馈的动态可靠性适应，解决AI代理工具检索中忽略工具可用性的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的工具检索方法主要优化语义相关性，而忽略了执行期间的工具可用性，导致AI代理行为不可靠。
AI.method: RATED采用冻结双编码器与对比微调进行语义匹配，并引入轻量级 contextual bandit 模块，根据实时执行反馈重排候选工具，无需昂贵的模型重训练即可快速适应运行时故障。
AI.result: 在EcoAgent基准上的实验表明，RATED在真实查询上较ToolLLM API检索器实现了52.2%的相对MRR提升，在30%故障率的严重API中断场景下将错误选择率从86.2%降至2.9%，且延迟开销不到1毫秒。
AI.conclusion: RATED能够在极低延迟下动态适应工具故障，显著提升了检索的可靠性与性能，并发布了EcoAgent基准以促进相关研究。

title: X-AgentRed: Red-Teaming Personal Agents in Evolving Multi-Service Ecosystems
summary: Personal agents increasingly connect to services across the web and applications by using tools. As the effects of their actions accumulate and interact across services, unintended or harmful outcomes can arise when agents fulfill benign user requests. Proactively identifying these compositional failures requires systematically exploring diverse cross-service paths. Existing red-teaming methods often simply prompt LLMs to identify potentially harmful paths from task and environment descriptions or decompose harmful objectives specified by humans or LLMs into seemingly benign action combinations. However, generation is biased toward patterns learned during training, potentially favoring familiar tool combinations and leaving novel cross-service interactions underexplored. To address this, we propose X-AgentRed, a self-evolving red-teaming framework that discovers harmful tool call paths through a graph of tool dependencies and expands and refines them using execution feedback. By analyzing each tool's effects, potential harms, and preconditions for execution, the red-teaming agent constructs a directed graph that captures how one tool's effects can satisfy another's execution preconditions. Recipes sampled from this graph are instantiated as realistic scenarios in which agents can produce harmful outcomes. Execution feedback enables self-improvement by diversifying paths that produce harm through tool substitution and refining preconditions at blocked steps in unsuccessful paths to enable further execution. Across four frontier agentic models, X-AgentRed achieves $1.77\times$ the harmful path rate of STAC and explores a more diverse set of tools, yielding $2.99\times$ the tool coverage on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出X-AgentRed，一个自我进化的红队框架，通过工具依赖图和执行反馈发现个人代理中潜在的有害工具调用路径。
AI.motivation: 个人代理在连接网络服务时可能因组合性失败产生意外或有害结果。现有红队方法偏向训练中学习到的模式，可能忽略新颖的跨服务交互，无法充分探索潜在的有害路径。
AI.method: X-AgentRed通过分析每个工具的效果、潜在危害和执行前置条件，构建有向图捕获工具间的依赖关系。从图中采样路径实例化为现实场景，利用执行反馈通过工具替换和细化前置条件实现自我改进。
AI.result: 在四个前沿代理模型上，X-AgentRed的有害路径率达到STAC的1.77倍，并探索了更多样化的工具集合，工具覆盖率达到STAC的2.99倍。
AI.conclusion: X-AgentRed能够有效发现个人代理中潜在的有害工具调用路径，相较于现有方法在有害路径率和工具覆盖率上均有显著提升，为代理安全性研究提供了新的框架。

title: Interacting Stochastic Systems with Agent-Based Sampling and Connection-Based Reinforcement
summary:
We introduce a general class of interacting reinforced stochastic systems evolving on a network. The dynamics are governed by two distinct interaction structures: a sampling network, which determines how information is acquired, and a reinforcement network, which determines how the sampled information influences future evolution. Processes generate Bernoulli observations through preferential, de-preferential, or mixed sampling, while observations are transmitted through an edge-dependent affine reinforcement mechanism.
  We formulate the dynamics as a stochastic approximation scheme and study their asymptotic behaviour. We establish sufficient conditions for almost sure convergence to a deterministic limit and, when the sampling and reinforcement graphs coincide, derive graph-theoretic criteria involving odd cycles, mixed-sampling vertices, and subcritical reinforcement. Under additional structural assumptions, we establish almost sure convergence and partial synchronization in a random-limit regime. In the deterministic regime, we also prove a law of the iterated logarithm and a central limit theorem under suitable spectral and regularity conditions. Finally, we show how the framework encompasses interacting urn models with edge-dependent reinforcement, urns with memory, and random walks with memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一类在网络上演化的交互式强化随机系统，通过随机逼近方法研究了其渐进行为及收敛性。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在解决网络上演化的交互式强化随机系统的渐进行为分析问题，特别是当信息采集网络和强化网络相互作用时如何确定其收敛性、同步性以及极限行为。
AI.method: 提出了一种由采样网络和强化网络双重结构支配的动态系统，将其表述为随机逼近方案，并采用基于边依赖的仿射强化机制处理伯努利观测值。
AI.result: 证明了几乎必然收敛到确定性极限的充分条件；推导了包含奇数环、混合采样顶点和亚临界强化的图论准则；在随机极限下证明了几乎必然收敛和部分同步；在确定性条件下证明了重对数律和中心极限定理。
AI.conclusion: 该理论框架具有广泛适用性，能够涵盖具有边依赖强化的交互式瓮模型、带记忆的瓮模型以及带记忆的随机游走，为多类复杂强化系统提供了统一的分析基础。

title: Ask Your Advisor: Learning When to Consult Stronger Models in Agentic Systems
summary: To balance task performance and computational cost, agentic workflows can use a lower-cost model for execution and selectively consult a stronger model. In such executor-advisor systems, the executor decides when to seek advice, making escalation depend on self-assessment, although current language models struggle to detect where their own reasoning fails. The need for stronger reasoning emerges during execution and varies across workflow phases. We introduce ARIA, a meta-controller that learns when to consult by balancing task success against consultation cost. Our approach formulates consultation as a sequential resource-allocation problem. At workflow contact points, ARIA maps execution evidence to a compact state abstraction and selects SILENT or CONSULT, with action values learned by Monte Carlo control from cost-penalized outcomes. Across evaluated tasks of SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.1, and $τ^2$-bench, ARIA recovers 44-81% of the executor-advisor success gap at less than half the advisor model's cost. ARIA achieves the best observed success-cost trade-off among ten other evaluated conditions, including routing and cascading methods, fixed and prompted consultation, and random placement at matched advice volume. The policies are compact and inspectable, with a single consultation-price parameter governing the success-cost trade-off without retraining either underlying model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ARIA元控制器，通过学习何时咨询更强模型来平衡任务性能与计算成本。
AI.motivation: 在执行者-顾问系统中，执行者决定何时寻求建议依赖于自我评估，但当前语言模型难以检测自身推理失败的位置，且对更强推理能力的需求在工作流不同阶段动态变化。
AI.method: ARIA将咨询建模为序列资源分配问题，在工作流接触点将执行证据映射为紧凑状态抽象，通过蒙特卡洛控制从成本惩罚的结果中学习动作值，选择SILENT或CONSULT动作。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.1和τ²-bench任务上，ARIA以不到顾问模型一半的成本恢复了44-81%的执行者-顾问成功差距，在十种对比条件下实现最佳成功-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: ARIA的策略紧凑且可检查，仅通过单一咨询价格参数即可控制成功-成本权衡，无需重新训练任一底层模型。

title: BT-Agent: Deploying Onboard Robot Agents with Behavior Trees and Multi-Fidelity Evaluation
summary: Deploying language-model agents onboard mobile robots requires task reasoning and responsive execution within limited compute and memory. We propose BT-Agent, an onboard architecture combining LLM-driven task decisions with predefined behavior-tree (BT) skills. These skills enforce execution conditions and return structured failure feedback. We demonstrate fully onboard operation with a 9B model on a quadruped across five task categories. Intervention tests show that local checks stop ongoing navigation without waiting for another model decision, while the agent remains active to retry or report constraints. To compare agent designs efficiently, we introduce a 161-task multi-fidelity benchmark, evaluated in text on all tasks and in Habitat on 39. Text supports 10.9$\times$ higher evaluation throughput, while simulation reveals how perception and motion failures change task outcomes. BT-Agent's largest success gains over the strongest Act/ReAct baseline occur at 4B and 9B: approximately 10 and 5 percentage points. Ablations identify structured tool calls and informative failure feedback as the most useful components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BT-Agent架构，将大语言模型决策与行为树技能相结合，在资源受限的移动机器人上实现了高效的任务推理与响应式执行。
AI.motivation: 在移动机器人上部署基于语言模型的代理时，需要在有限的计算和内存下进行任务推理和快速响应执行，同时需要高效比较不同代理设计的方法。
AI.method: 提出BT-Agent机载架构，结合大语言模型任务决策与预定义行为树(BT)技能，以强制执行条件并返回结构化失败反馈；同时引入一个161任务的多保真度基准进行评估。
AI.result: 在四足机器人上使用9B模型实现了完全机载操作；局部检查无需等待模型决策即可停止导航；文本评估吞吐量提高10.9倍；相比最强Act/ReAct基线，4B和9B模型成功率分别提升约10和5个百分点；消融实验表明结构化工具调用和失败反馈最有效。
AI.conclusion: 结合LLM与行为树的BT-Agent有效解决了资源受限下机器人的任务执行与快速响应问题，结构化反馈机制是提升性能的关键。

title: Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that sits outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state. Our results suggest that full-snapshot search is most effective when long-horizon coding work spans multiple services whose state cannot be reconstructed from a single diff.
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Preprint. Not peer reviewed

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用完整Daytona快照进行Go-Explore式搜索，以解决编码代理的失败恢复问题并有效利用跨服务运行时状态。
AI.motivation: 编码代理在失败前常取得有意义的进展，但从头重试会丢弃这些中间状态。文章旨在解决失败恢复的搜索问题，探究从中间状态恢复和分支是否优于从初始状态重启。
AI.method: 在完整的Daytona快照上实现Go-Explore风格的搜索，通过恢复和分支中间环境状态来进行失败恢复。
AI.result: 实验发现，更高且更高效的解决率主要依赖于代码库之外的进展，例如数据库、服务及其他运行时状态。
AI.conclusion: 当长周期编码工作涉及多个服务且其状态无法从单个代码差异中重建时，全快照搜索方法最为有效。

title: MC-EvoBench: Auditing Experience-Driven Self-Improvement in Minecraft Agents
summary: A central challenge in embodied recursive self-improvement is enabling agents to convert interaction history into capabilities that persist beyond one world and transfer to later tasks. A saved memory or successful final action does not by itself establish that a reusable capability was acquired; evaluation must separate capability change from carried-over resources, unequal source exposure, and early execution failures. We construct MC-EvoBench as a controlled Minecraft benchmark with a fixed catalog of 19 registered evolution chains, including 12 primary evaluation chains and seven calibration or probe chains, together with three graph-aligned paired probe families for transfer. The benchmark represents each task as a task-state graph, defines stage-level environment verifiers, assigns matched source and target roles, resets the target world, and permits only a declared agent artifact to cross the source-target boundary. For each probe, no-prior, related, unrelated, and shuffled source conditions are evaluated under matched environment-step budgets and five seeds; we report TSR, WGP, and VMP and retain provenance records. The benchmark reveals a consistent direct-capability gap between controller and planner-backed variants, while related experience yields no stable transfer: it does not improve either tool probe, its small wood-species gain hinges on one seed, and all intervals include zero. Stage audits further show that early wood-collection and crafting bottlenecks often leave later capabilities unobserved. MC-EvoBench thus offers a controlled testbed for durable, transferable embodied capabilities. Code and data are available at https://github.com/xzw-ustc/mc-bench-open-source

AI.tldr: 本文构建了MC-EvoBench，一个受控的Minecraft基准测试，用于评估具身智能体持久且可迁移的能力获取。
AI.motivation: 具身递归自我改进中的核心挑战是验证智能体是否真正获得了可重用能力，而非依赖携带资源、不对等暴露或早期执行失败。现有评估缺乏对能力变化的严格分离与控制。
AI.method: 构建包含19条注册进化链（12条主评估链、7条校准/探针链）及三个图对齐配对探针族的MC-EvoBench基准。每个任务表示为任务状态图，定义阶段级环境验证器，分配匹配的源/目标角色，重置目标世界，仅允许声明的智能体产物跨源-目标边界。在匹配环境步预算和五个种子下评估无先验、相关、无关及打乱源条件，报告TSR、WGP和VMP并保留溯源记录。
AI.result: 基准揭示了控制器与规划器支持变体之间一致的直接能力差距；相关经验未产生稳定迁移，不改善工具探针表现，其微小的木材种类增益仅依赖一个种子且所有区间包含零。阶段审计显示早期木材收集与制作瓶颈常导致后续能力无法被观察到。
AI.conclusion: MC-EvoBench提供了一个受控测试环境，能够严格分离能力变化与混淆因素，为持久、可迁移的具身能力评估奠定了基础。代码和数据已开源。

title: DynaTE: Accelerating Diffusion LLMs via Dynamic Token Execution
summary:
Diffusion-based LLMs (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs by enabling bidirectional parallel refinement, alleviating the sequential decoding bottleneck of AR generation. However, their parallel iterative refinement mismatches AR accelerators optimized for sequential decoding and their discrete token generation differs from DiT accelerators designed for continuous denoising. Recent dLLM accelerators have explored workload-specific optimizations to reduce vocabulary processing overhead and redundant computation across denoising iterations. However, these approaches retain all tokens in parallel execution, despite varying token refinement utility and execution requirements.
  This paper presents DynaTE, a hardware--software co-design architecture that dynamically adapts accelerator execution to evolving token states during dLLM decoding. DynaTE first enables adaptive token execution by skipping low-utility token computation, while a dimension-reconfigurable PE array maintains high utilization under varying active-token patterns. Second, DynaTE exploits dynamic token dependencies through FLDD to refine a small number of locally dependent tokens within the current iteration, reducing the overall number of denoising iterations, while a Merge--Split--Merge dataflow hides the resulting serial overhead. Third, a streaming vocabulary engine interleaves multiple token streams from the LM head to accommodate irregular output variations caused by selective token computation and uneven vocabulary-selection demands.
  Evaluated on two representative dLLMs, DynaTE achieves 2.05--2.78$\times$ speedup and 2.99--3.93$\times$ higher energy efficiency over state-of-the-art dLLM accelerators, while delivering 2.55$\times$ speedup and 6.07$\times$ higher energy efficiency over Jetson AGX Orin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DynaTE软硬件协同设计架构，通过动态适应加速器执行以应对dLLM解码过程中token状态的变化，实现显著的加速和能效提升。
AI.motivation: 现有dLLM加速器虽然优化了词汇处理和冗余计算，但仍保留所有token的并行执行，忽略了不同token在细化过程中的效用和执行需求差异，导致资源浪费和性能未充分优化。
AI.method: DynaTE采用三项核心技术：1) 自适应token执行跳过低效用token计算，配合维度可重构PE阵列维持高利用率；2) 通过FLDD实现动态token依赖，在迭代内细化局部依赖token以减少去噪迭代次数，使用Merge-Split-Merge数据流隐藏串行开销；3) 流式词汇引擎交错多token流，适应选择性计算带来的不规则输出变化。
AI.result: 在两个代表性dLLM上评估，DynaTE相比最先进的dLLM加速器实现2.05-2.78倍加速和2.99-3.93倍能效提升，相比Jetson AGX Orin实现2.55倍加速和6.07倍能效提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过软硬件协同设计动态适应dLLM解码过程中token状态的变化，可显著提升性能和能效，为dLLM的高效部署提供了有效解决方案。

title: Omni-Diffusion-Distill: Few-Step Distillation of Unified Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Unified multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a single architecture for both image generation and multimodal understanding, but their iterative decoding requires tens to hundreds of forward passes. Existing few-step distillation methods largely focus on either image generation or text generation, making it unclear how to compress a fully discrete multimodal dLLM into a single efficient student while preserving both generation and understanding. We introduce Omni-Diffusion-Distill, a unified two-stage distillation framework that retains strong generation and understanding capabilities while substantially reducing the inference cost of a unified multimodal dLLM. Omni-Diffusion-Distill aligns the distillation of both generation and understanding, for both images and text, in the discrete token space. In the first stage, the student is trained to skip decoding steps by replaying cached teacher trajectories, and in the second stage the student is refined on intermediate states along its own rollouts. We further remedy two sources of degradation in unified distillation with a pairwise collision penalty that reduces repetition under parallel text decoding, and entropy-matched guidance that prevents entropy collapse caused by fitting the sharpened teacher distribution in image generation. Omni-Diffusion-Distill achieves state-of-the-art trade-offs between decoding efficiency and generation and understanding performance for multimodal dLLMs, reducing image generation from 128 to 8 decoding steps and multimodal understanding from 512 to 64, giving 18.2x and 21.2x wall-clock speedups. Under these budgets, it scores 0.828 on GenEval and 83.0 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation, while reaching GPT judge scores of 20.0 on MM-Vet and 57.2 on COCO captioning (twice the teacher's 28.4 at the same steps) for multimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Omni-Diffusion-Distill，一个统一的两阶段蒸馏框架，用于压缩多模态扩散大语言模型，在保留生成和理解能力的同时大幅减少推理步骤。
AI.motivation: 统一的多模态扩散大语言模型(dLLMs)虽然能同时处理图像生成和多模态理解，但其迭代解码需要数十到数百次前向传递，推理成本高昂。现有少步蒸馏方法主要关注单一模态(图像或文本生成)，尚不清楚如何将完全离散的多模态dLLM压缩为单一高效学生模型，同时保持生成和理解能力。
AI.method: 提出Omni-Diffusion-Distill两阶段蒸馏框架，在离散token空间中对齐图像和文本的生成与理解蒸馏。第一阶段通过重放缓存的教师轨迹训练学生模型跳过解码步骤；第二阶段在学生自身rollout的中间状态上进行精炼。此外引入两项技术：成对碰撞惩罚(pairwise collision penalty)减少并行文本解码中的重复，以及熵匹配引导(entropy-matched guidance)防止图像生成中因拟合锐化教师分布导致的熵崩溃。
AI.result: 在解码效率与生成/理解性能之间实现了最先进权衡。图像生成从128步降至8步，获得18.2倍墙钟加速；多模态理解从512步降至64步，获得21.2倍加速。在此预算下，文本到图像生成GenEval得分0.828、DPG-Bench得分83.0；多模态理解MM-Vet GPT判分20.0、COCO字幕生成57.2(相同步数下为教师模型28.4的两倍)。
AI.conclusion: Omni-Diffusion-Distill成功解决了统一多模态dLLM蒸馏中的关键挑战，在大幅提升推理效率的同时保持甚至超越了教师模型在生成和理解任务上的性能，为多模态扩散模型的实际部署提供了有效方案。

title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
summary: Planning is increasingly important for long-horizon agents, where successful execution requires coordinating subgoals, tool use, and intermediate outcomes over many steps. Yet assumptions made during planning may be invalidated by the environment, tools may return unexpected results, or actions may fail. Effective agents must therefore not only generate plans, but also revise them. Such revisions often affect only part of a plan, leaving the preceding and subsequent structure intact. Rather than regenerate the entire plan and risk unnecessary changes, repair can regenerate the affected region conditioned on the preserved prefix and suffix. We introduce Plan-and-Patch, a plan-and-act framework in which a diffusion language model (dLLM) generates a structured, program-like plan through parallel unmasking and repairs it by filling in selected regions while keeping the surrounding steps fixed. We compare DreamReasoner-8B and Qwen3-8B as diffusion and autoregressive (AR) planners. On Natural Plan without task-specific training, diffusion (53.7%) achieves nearly twice the plan repair success rate of AR (27.0%). After task-specific training on agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and TextCraft, the planners achieve similar observed success in plan generation, while diffusion reduces mean plan-generation latency by 39-46% relative to AR. Our results show that Plan-and-Patch provides a framework for faster plan generation and effective plan repair in long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Plan-and-Patch框架，利用扩散语言模型(dLLM)通过并行解码生成结构化计划，并通过局部修复机制在保留前后步骤的前提下修补受影响区域，实现更快、更有效的长程智能体计划生成与修复。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体在执行过程中常遇到环境变化、工具返回异常或动作失败等问题，需要修改计划。然而传统方法重新生成整个计划会带来不必要的变更和延迟，因此需要一种能够仅修复受影响区域的高效计划修复方法。
AI.method: 提出Plan-and-Patch框架，使用扩散语言模型(dLLM)通过并行unmasking生成类程序的结构化计划；当计划需要修复时，仅对选定区域进行填充生成，同时保持前后步骤固定不变。对比了DreamReasoner-8B(扩散)和Qwen3-8B(自回归)两种规划器。
AI.result: 在Natural Plan上无需任务特定训练时，扩散模型的计划修复成功率(53.7%)接近自回归模型(27.0%)的两倍；在ALFWorld和TextCraft上进行任务特定训练后，两种规划器的计划生成成功率相近，但扩散模型将平均计划生成延迟降低了39-46%。
AI.conclusion: Plan-and-Patch框架为长程智能体提供了更快的计划生成和有效的计划修复能力，扩散语言模型在计划修复成功率和生成延迟方面均优于自回归模型，展示了扩散模型在智能体规划任务中的潜力。

title: Enhancing Diffusion Language Models with Autoregressive Post-Training Weights
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) language models, offering flexible token-update orders and parallel decoding. Recent dLLMs are often initialized from pretrained AR models before diffusion conversion in order to inherit their learned representations. After the conversion, however, they typically ignore the extensive post-training ecosystem of their AR ancestors. In this work, we show that these existing AR post-training weight updates can instead be effectively recycled to enhance diffusion models. Despite the changes by AR-to-diffusion conversion, directly adding an AR post-training weight update to a diffusion base model remains effective, bringing its performance close to that achieved by direct diffusion post-training. Notably, AR and diffusion post-training updates are nearly orthogonal in weight space, yet induce substantially more aligned representation changes in the diffusion model. Their distinct updates are also complementary: composing their weights can retain gains from both regimes and further improve the post-trained diffusion model. Based on these findings, we propose A2D, a simple training-free framework for enhancing diffusion models with existing AR post-training resources. A2D can transfer capabilities from AR post-trained models to diffusion base models, and further improve already post-trained diffusion models by composing AR and diffusion post-training updates. Across various dLLMs, including Dream, DreamReasoner, DiffuCoder, Dream-Coder, Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion, and DiffusionGemma, A2D reliably improves instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and coding with both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning updates, without additional training, or inference-time computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的A2D框架，通过回收自回归模型的后训练权重更新来增强扩散语言模型的能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（dLLMs）在从自回归（AR）模型转换后通常忽略了AR模型丰富的后训练资源。本文旨在解决如何有效利用这些AR后训练权重更新来增强dLLMs的问题。
AI.method: 提出A2D框架，直接将AR后训练权重更新添加到扩散基础模型中。该方法发现AR和扩散后训练更新在权重空间中近乎正交且互补，因此通过组合两者的权重来保留并融合各自的性能增益。
AI.result: 在多种扩散语言模型上的实验表明，A2D无需额外训练或推理计算开销，即可在指令遵循、数学推理和编程任务上持续提升模型性能，适用于监督微调和强化学习更新。
AI.conclusion: 直接添加AR后训练更新到扩散模型中是有效的，且AR与扩散后训练更新具有互补性；A2D框架成功实现了跨范式的后训练资源转移与能力提升。

title: SoloQ: Calibration-Free Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models through bidirectional diffusion-based token generation. However, their growing model sizes and high inference costs make efficient deployment challenging: full-sequence denoising repeatedly invokes compute-intensive forward passes, while block-diffusion models additionally introduce a memory-intensive KV-cache. Low-bit weight-activation quantization is therefore attractive, yet existing dLLM post-training quantization methods rely on calibration data despite activation distributions shifting across masking states and denoising steps. We present SoloQ, a calibration-free quantization framework that maps weights and activations into a normalized rotated basis with a predictable marginal distribution, enabling data-independent quantization. SoloQ combines a structured K-RPBH rotation with a lightweight rescaling correction for calibration-free quantization. Its predictable post-rotation distribution supports both distribution-matched codebooks and hardware-native NVFP4. For block-diffusion models, SoloQ further applies commit-time KV-cache quantization to compress persistent states without perturbing the actively denoised block. Across full-sequence dLLMs (LLaDA and Dream) and block-diffusion dLLMs(Fast-dLLM v2 and Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion), SoloQ retains accuracy under 4-bit quantization and outperforms calibration-based baselines on knowledge- and reasoning-intensive benchmarks. With NVFP4, SoloQ reduces peak memory by up to 2.61X and accelerates end-to-end inference by up to 2.24X.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SoloQ，一个无需校准数据的量化框架，用于高效部署扩散大语言模型(dLLMs)。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型的模型规模不断增长且推理成本高，全序列去噪反复调用计算密集的前向传播，块扩散模型还引入了内存密集的KV缓存。现有的dLLM后训练量化方法依赖校准数据，而激活分布在不同掩码状态和去噪步骤间会发生偏移。
AI.method: SoloQ将权重和激活映射到具有可预测边际分布的归一化旋转基中，实现数据无关的量化。该方法结合了结构化K-RPBH旋转和轻量级缩放校正，支持分布匹配的码本和硬件原生NVFP4格式。对于块扩散模型，SoloQ还在提交时对KV缓存进行量化，压缩持久状态而不干扰正在去噪的块。
AI.result: 在全序列dLLMs（LLaDA和Dream）和块扩散dLLMs（Fast-dLLM v2和Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion）上，SoloQ在4-bit量化下保持准确率，并在知识和推理密集型基准上优于基于校准的基线方法。使用NVFP4时，SoloQ将峰值内存降低最多2.61倍，端到端推理加速最多2.24倍。
AI.conclusion: SoloQ证明了无需校准数据的量化方法在扩散大语言模型上的有效性，通过可预测的旋转后分布实现了高精度的低比特量化，同时显著降低了内存消耗和推理延迟，为dLLMs的高效部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Noise Out, Bias In: Targeted Bias Injection in Diffusion Language Models via Closed-Loop Activation Steering
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked positions, re-predicting each token multiple times before it is committed. An autoregressive decoder exposes an answer's distribution once, at the step that commits it; a dLLM exposes it at every denoising step before commitment, and we show that an adversary can exploit this. Since an answer remains open to revision over many denoising steps, an adversary with access to internal activations can watch how likely the model is to produce a chosen answer and adjust the intervention accordingly. Building on this observation, we study targeted bias injection, an attack that steers a frozen dLLM toward a demographic answer selected by the adversary. The attack uses a simple proportional-integral (PI) controller that tracks the target-answer probability during denoising and adapts the strength of a steering vector on the fly. On ambiguous BBQ questions where the correct answer is abstention, our attack raises LLaDA-8B-Instruct's preference for the targeted group from 1.8 to 16.7 percentage points, more than three times the strongest fixed-strength steering baseline, and on SocialStigmaQA it raises the selection of stigmatizing answers from 17.6% to 58.1%. Fitted to other demographic targets, the same attack shifts answers by up to 37 percentage points, and each attack takes about 40 minutes on one GPU. On the primary target, feedback is what makes the attack work: constant steering at the same average strength over the token-committing steps produces a far smaller shift while corrupting nearly three times as many outputs, and a constant strength set separately for each example still falls well short. Our findings identify the denoising trajectory as a new control channel in dLLMs and call for bias audits that examine the serving stack rather than the frozen model alone.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了掩码扩散语言模型在去噪轨迹中的安全漏洞，并提出一种基于比例积分控制器的偏见注入攻击方法。
AI.motivation: 与自回归解码器仅暴露一次答案分布不同，掩码扩散语言模型在提交答案前的每次去噪步骤中都会暴露该分布。本文旨在利用这一特性，解决如何通过监控内部激活并动态调整干预，从而向冻结的模型注入针对性偏见的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于比例积分（PI）控制器的攻击方法。该方法在去噪过程中实时跟踪目标答案的概率，并动态调整导向向量的强度，从而引导冻结的模型输出攻击者选定的特定群体答案。
AI.result: 在BBQ和社会污名问答数据集上，该攻击将模型对目标群体的偏好从1.8%提升至16.7%，将选择污名化答案的比例从17.6%提升至58.1%。对于其他目标群体，答案偏移高达37个百分点，每次攻击仅需约40分钟单GPU时间。与固定强度的导向方法相比，基于反馈的动态调整效果更好且破坏的输出更少。
AI.conclusion: 去噪轨迹是扩散语言模型中的一种新型控制通道。研究结果表明，未来的偏见审计不能仅局限于冻结的模型，而应涵盖整个服务技术栈。

title: Mask-Guided KV Cache Eviction in Block Diffusion Language Models
summary: Block diffusion language models keep a large key-value (KV) cache throughout generation and attend to it at every denoising step, limiting both memory capacity and generation speed. Reducing these costs requires deciding which past tokens to use for denoising the current block (selection) and which to keep in memory for future blocks (eviction). We propose MaskAhead, a training-free method that solves both tasks with a single mask-query-based ranking mechanism. Current-block masks guide selection, while probes of upcoming masked blocks guide eviction. Both rank KV entries by their estimated contribution to the attention output. Our quantized variant, Q-MaskAhead, computes selection and attention directly from low-bit KV, largely preserving the selected entries. Experiments on Fast-dLLM-v2, DreamReasoner, and LLaDA2.0-mini cover long-generation reasoning, long-prompt question answering, and needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. On long-prompt QA, MaskAhead reduces KV memory by $9.5\times$ on average with a 1.2-point mean F1 loss relative to dense inference. Q-MaskAhead increases the reduction to $20.1\times$ with a 2.3-point mean F1 loss. In a batch-32 systems profile, MaskAhead achieves $1.23\times$ end-to-end and $1.68\times$ decode-stage speedups over dense inference.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的MaskAhead方法，利用基于掩码查询的排名机制同时解决块扩散语言模型中KV缓存的选择与淘汰问题，显著降低内存开销并提升生成速度。
AI.motivation: 块扩散语言模型在整个生成过程中维持庞大的KV缓存并在每个去噪步骤中进行注意力计算，限制了内存容量和生成速度。降低这些成本需要决定使用哪些过去的令牌进行去噪（选择）以及在内存中保留哪些令牌供未来块使用（淘汰）。
AI.method: 提出MaskAhead，一种无需训练的方法，通过单一的基于掩码查询的排名机制同时解决选择和淘汰任务。当前块的掩码指导选择，对即将到来的掩码块的探测指导淘汰，两者均通过对注意力输出的估计贡献对KV条目进行排名。其量化变体Q-MaskAhead直接从低比特KV计算选择和注意力。
AI.result: 在长提示问答任务中，MaskAhead平均将KV内存减少9.5倍，平均F1仅损失1.2分；Q-MaskAhead将内存减少提升至20.1倍，F1损失2.3分。在batch-32的系统评测中，MaskAhead实现了1.23倍的端到端加速和1.68倍的解码阶段加速。
AI.conclusion: MaskAhead有效解决了块扩散语言模型中KV缓存的内存与速度瓶颈，通过高效的、无需训练的机制在极小性能损失下实现了显著的内存节省和推理加速。

title: SpecFold: Folding Multi-Branch Redundancy for Faster Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (DLLMs) generate text through iterative block denoising, and multi-branch speculative decoding accelerates this process by verifying a main branch together with multiple draft branches in a single forward pass. While prior DLLM acceleration methods primarily exploit temporal redundancy across denoising steps, we identify a complementary redundancy axis within each speculative verification step: multi-branch computational redundancy. During speculative verification, draft branches inherit most tokens from their parents while unmasking a small set of additional positions, causing large portions of hidden states to remain highly similar across branches. We propose SpecFold, an algorithm-system co-design that exploits this multi-branch redundancy to reduce the cost of multi-branch speculative verification. Algorithmically, SpecFold performs token-level residual gating and selectively reuses parent computation through folded attention and FFN while preserving residual hidden states. Systemically, a Triton kernel implementation translates this fine-grained reuse into end-to-end throughput gains through efficient sparse multi-branch execution. SpecFold is orthogonal to temporal caching and compatible with existing DLLM speculation strategies. Across two DLLM families, five models, and five standard benchmarks, SpecFold achieves up to 1.64x throughput over Spiffy and up to 1.99x over vanilla decoding, while maintaining comparable task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpecFold，一种通过利用多分支计算冗余来加速扩散语言模型推测解码的算法-系统协同设计方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散语言模型加速方法忽略了推测验证步骤中的多分支计算冗余（即草稿分支与父分支的隐藏状态高度相似），本文旨在利用该冗余来降低多分支推测验证的计算成本。
AI.method: SpecFold采用算法-系统协同设计：算法上通过token级残差门控和折叠注意力与FFN选择性重用父分支计算；系统上通过Triton内核实现高效的稀疏多分支执行以提升端到端吞吐量。
AI.result: 在多个模型和基准测试中，SpecFold的吞吐量比Spiffy高出1.64倍，比普通解码高出1.99倍，同时保持了相当的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: SpecFold成功利用多分支冗余加速了DLLMs，该方法与现有的时间缓存和推测策略正交兼容，具有显著的性能提升效果。

title: Preserving Mathematical Reasoning in Compressed Diffusion Language Models via Trajectory-Aware Low-Rank Approximation
summary: Diffusion language model (dLLM) compression faces a known challenge because calibration is typically performed on clean, fully visible activations, whereas inference traverses partially masked intermediate states. For low-rank compression, this raises two questions. First, can low-rank optimality still be characterized when approximation quality is measured over trajectory-distributed states, and second, does the choice of calibration states affect mathematical reasoning preservation under compression? We address these questions by formulating a trajectory-aware low-rank objective over corruption levels and masking realizations. To estimate this objective efficiently, we propose Traj-MC, which estimates the trajectory second moment through Monte Carlo sampling and yields exact sampled-state optimality and population consistency. Under matched compression budgets, trajectory-aware calibration improves reconstruction over the generation trajectory and preserves substantially more mathematical reasoning than clean calibration on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Our results connect trajectory-aware low-rank optimality to the reasoning capability retained after dLLM compression. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Zishan-Shao/traj-mc.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨迹感知的低秩校准方法Traj-MC，解决扩散语言模型压缩中校准与推理状态不匹配的问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型压缩面临校准状态（完全可见的激活）与推理状态（部分掩码的中间状态）不匹配的挑战。本文旨在解决低秩压缩在轨迹分布状态下的最优性表征问题，以及校准状态的选择对压缩后数学推理能力的影响。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于损坏级别和掩码实现的轨迹感知低秩目标函数。提出Traj-MC方法，利用蒙特卡洛采样估计轨迹二阶矩，以实现精确的采样状态最优性和总体一致性。
AI.result: 在同等压缩预算下，轨迹感知校准不仅改善了生成轨迹上的重构质量，还在数学推理基准测试中比传统干净校准保留了显著更多的数学推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹感知的低秩最优性能够有效连接并解释扩散语言模型压缩后所保留的推理能力。

title: Context-Tower Conversion Preserves Generation While Freezing Retains Knowledge: Low-Budget AR-to-Diffusion Conversion of MoE LLMs
summary: Converting a pretrained autoregressive (AR) model to a diffusion language model (dLLM) enables parallel generation without pretraining a new model. Published conversion methods differ by roughly three orders of magnitude in training data and have not been compared under a common protocol. We compare two conversions of the same 30B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) parent, holding the corpus, supervised-token budget, trainable parameter set and evaluation harness fixed, each under its own training recipe. The in-place model updates a subset of the parent's weights using denoising and representation-alignment losses; the frozen-tower model instead conditions through cross-attention on a frozen causal copy of the parent. With 1B training tokens, the frozen-tower model scores 71.60 on HumanEval pass@10 against 6.19 for the in-place model, an 11.6x improvement. At the same budget it also keeps 95% of the parent's GSM8K score and 99% of its MMLU-Pro score. A dense-parent experiment reproduces the HumanEval separation. Within the two-tower design at about 500M tokens, freezing the context tower retains substantially more MMLU-Pro performance than training it, while both give similar observed HumanEval scores. Our theoretical analysis establishes that both conversion classes contain an exact sampler for the AR parent under a hard attention mask and left-to-right commitment of one position per round. Under a shared loss, freezing removes the gradient contribution through the context states. Furthermore, evaluation protocol substantially affects a published 500B-token conversion's scores in both directions across tasks, while its AR parent's scores vary by less than three points, so comparing dLLMs needs a common protocol. These results show that, in the tested low-budget regime, the frozen-tower configuration retains substantially more of the parent's generation performance than in-place conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了将自回归模型转换为扩散语言模型的就地更新和冻结塔两种方法，发现在低预算训练下冻结塔方法能显著更好地保留父模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决不同自回归（AR）模型到扩散语言模型（dLLM）转换方法因训练数据量差异巨大且缺乏统一评估协议而无法有效比较的问题。
AI.method: 在固定语料、参数和评估协议下，对比了同一30B MoE父模型的两种转换法：通过去噪和表示对齐损失更新部分权重的就地模型，以及通过交叉注意力连接冻结因果副本的冻结塔模型，并辅以理论分析。
AI.result: 在10亿token预算下，冻结塔模型在HumanEval pass@10上得分为71.60，较就地模型的6.19提升11.6倍，且保留了95%的GSM8K和99%的MMLU-Pro分数。此外，评估协议对得分影响显著，冻结上下文塔在约5亿token时能更好地保留MMLU-Pro性能。
AI.conclusion: 在低训练预算下，冻结塔配置比就地转换能更有效地保留父模型的生成和推理性能；同时，统一评估协议对于dLLM的对比至关重要。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出树退出验证（TEV）和退出引导草稿树训练（ExitTrain）方法，通过优化验证过程和草稿树构建来改进推测解码。
AI.motivation: 基于树的推测解码中，由草稿分数构建的有限树面临根本的草稿-目标不匹配问题。本文旨在解决该问题，探索更好的精确验证能否在固定树上提高接受率，以及目标反馈如何改进树本身。
AI.method: 作者通过目标流视角确定了规范退出定律，并由此提出了树退出验证（TEV），这是一种精确的层级并行过程。同时，利用退出定律识别缺失的目标概率，为退出引导草稿树训练（ExitTrain）提供节点级反馈。
AI.result: 在对话、代码和数学推理任务上的实验表明，ExitTrain将平均输出块长度增加了13%，而TEV将验证器阶段延迟降低了15%，相比DDTree实现了14%的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果指出了推测解码中的两个优化机会：构建更好的草稿树以提高接受率，以及采用更直接的验证以降低延迟。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting tokens and verifying them in parallel. Block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash model only per-position marginals, and tree methods such as DDTree expand candidate trees from those marginals. The released Domino drafter adds a GRU-based causal correction making each draft token's distribution path-dependent, a structure DDTree's factorized formulation cannot represent. We introduce DominoTree, a training-free best-first draft tree scored by Domino's conditional (non-factorized) correction along each root-to-node path, made practical by restricting the per-node correction to a candidate top-M. We evaluate it on eight benchmarks in a single-stream harness, and in SGLang, where it runs as an out-of-tree plugin against AR, DFlash, EAGLE-3 and Domino under identical flags. DominoTree attains the highest mean accepted length in every serving cell - two model sizes, single-request and concurrent load, context to 32K - and the highest Overall accepted length at every temperature in the research harness (21 of 24 per-dataset cells). A three-arm decomposition holding drafter, budget and verifier fixed separates the gain from applying the correction at all (+10.1% accepted length) from that of recomputing it along each candidate's realized path (+4.7% more), the part this paper adds. Where the round is verify-dominated, throughput follows: up to 7.3x over AR on Qwen3-8B, beating the released Domino decoder at its CUDA-graph best at every temperature, and inside SGLang winning single-request throughput by +12% over Domino on Qwen3-8B. On HELMET long context it beats Domino by +29-36% accepted length and +10-34% throughput at every length and both model sizes. Past a memory-constrained card's admission cap the chain wins goodput, and at our longest context, where prefill dominates, our lead over EAGLE-3 narrows to a tie.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DominoTree，一种无需训练的优先搜索草稿树，通过利用Domino的非因式分解条件校正来优化大语言模型的推测解码。
AI.motivation: 现有的树状推测解码方法（如DDTree）基于因式分解公式，无法表示像Domino这种具有基于GRU因果校正的草稿器所引入的路径依赖分布。
AI.method: 提出DominoTree，一种无需训练的best-first draft tree，通过沿着每条从根到节点的路径对Domino的条件（非因式分解）校正进行评分，并通过将每个节点的校正限制在候选top-M内来使其切实可行。
AI.result: 在所有服务单元（两种模型大小、单请求和并发负载、最高32K上下文）中实现了最高的平均接受长度，并在所有温度下的研究测试中获得了最高的总体接受长度（24个数据集单元中的21个）。相较于自回归（AR），在Qwen3-8B上吞吐量最高提升7.3倍；在SGLang中单请求吞吐量比Domino高12%。在HELMET长上下文基准测试中，接受长度比Domino高29-36%，吞吐量高10-34%。
AI.conclusion: DominoTree通过有效利用非因式分解路径依赖校正，在多种上下文和服务设置下显著提升了接受长度和吞吐量，尽管在由预填充主导的最长上下文中，其相对于EAGLE-3的优势缩小至持平。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GRAFT框架，通过改进边评分和动态预算分配，解决了基于扩散语言模型的推测解码中的草稿树构建问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的树构建方法与扩散语言模型（DLM）草稿器不兼容，且当前的DDTree方法仅依赖词元概率选择边导致父子节点不匹配，同时固定预算未考虑吞吐量最优树大小的动态变化。
AI.method: GRAFT引入了目标蒸馏边评分（TDES），利用目标模型轨迹提取父子偏好以选择兼容边；并提出状态感知预算分配（SABA），通过平衡预期草稿增益与验证成本来动态设置每轮的树预算。
AI.result: 在多个模型和任务上，GRAFT相比自回归解码实现了2.13倍至6.36倍的端到端加速，每轮额外开销不到0.5毫秒（约占目标模型验证延迟的1.4%）。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT有效弥合了DLM草稿器与树构建方法之间的差距，以极低的额外开销显著提升了推测解码的加速效果。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CaDDTree（成本感知扩散起草树），通过联合选择树结构和节点预算来优化推测解码的token吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的块扩散起草树（如DDTree）在固定节点预算下最大化预期接受长度，但由于接受长度随预算非递减，导致其偏向构建更大的树而忽略验证成本，缺乏原则性的预算选择机制。
AI.method: CaDDTree通过显式建模起草和验证延迟，直接优化token吞吐量。该方法将吞吐量目标分解为每轮对预算的一维搜索，并在凸验证成本下证明吞吐量函数是单峰的，从而实现高效的贪心停止规则。它无需离线预算搜索，能根据当前位置分布和验证成本在每轮自适应调整预算。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型上跨8个基准测试（涵盖推理、编码和指令跟随任务）的实验表明，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上均匹配或超越了使用oracle预算选择的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree为推测解码提供了一种原则性且自适应的吞吐量优化方法，通过动态调整树预算和结构，在不依赖离线搜索的情况下实现了出色的推理加速效果。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TAPS方法，通过选择紧凑的前缀闭合子树来优化推测解码中的验证过程，有效解决了草稿树扩展带来的延迟问题。
AI.motivation: 在使用扩散模型进行并行草拟以加速推测解码时，验证过程成为了新的瓶颈。现有方法基于边缘概率对草稿树节点进行排序，忽略了验证是基于前缀条件的，导致会验证被拒绝前缀的不可达后代，增加延迟且接受率提升有限。
AI.method: 提出TAPS（目标感知前缀选择）方法，将扩散边缘概率转化为路径条件接受估计，并在固定的验证预算下选择一个紧凑的前缀闭合子树，以优化接受率与成本的权衡。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和模型上的实验表明，TAPS相比原始自回归解码实现了高达7.9倍的无损端到端加速，且比最先进的DFlash和DDTree分别快1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS通过改进接受与成本的权衡而非简单扩展草稿树，有效解决了验证瓶颈，为无损加速自回归解码提供了一种高效方法。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DDTree方法，利用块扩散草稿模型的位置分布直接构建草稿树，在单次前向传播中验证多个候选轨迹，显著提升推测解码性能。
AI.motivation: DFlash虽然能在单次前向传播中生成整个草稿块并达到SOTA性能，但每轮仍只验证单一草稿轨迹，限制了接受长度，因此需要一种方法来利用块扩散草稿模型的分布信息构建多分支草稿树以提高接受率。
AI.method: DDTree从块扩散草稿模型的逐位置分布中构建草稿树，在固定节点预算下使用最佳优先堆算法，根据草稿模型输出定义的代理指标选择最可能匹配目标模型的续写候选，然后使用仅祖先注意力掩码在单次目标模型前向传播中高效验证该树。
AI.result: DDTree建立在领先的草稿模型DFlash之上，其增益使其跻身推测解码的前沿方法之列，超越了EAGLE-3等强自回归草稿器。
AI.conclusion: DDTree证明了通过块扩散分布构建草稿树可以有效提升推测解码的接受长度和整体性能，为推测解码领域提供了新的领先方案。

title: S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models
summary: Multimodal language models (MLLMs) exhibit promising spatial reasoning capabilities, yet the internal mechanisms supporting them remain poorly understood. We uncover S-Space, a linear representation subspace in which object-token representations encode continuous coordinates along horizontal, vertical, and distance axes. Although we identify these axes by differentiating spatial-answer scores with respect to object-token activations, S-Space is intrinsic rather than induced by specific data or prompts, remaining readable under non-spatial questions. We show that S-Space functions as an internal spatial workspace of MLLMs. Perception encodes object locations into it, forming spatial representations that can be directly read out to support accurate spatial judgments. Internal reasoning transforms it for changing viewpoints. Verbal responses selectively access it, evidenced by causal interventions that alter spatial judgments while largely preserving non-spatial responses. Case studies further show that S-Space assigns locations to unseen entities and the observer, and connects physical directions with abstract linguistic meanings, suggesting both the capabilities and limitations of large-scale language training. Finally, we use S-Space as a diagnostic tool for spatial reasoning failures. Direction-word readouts reveal systematic coupling between cardinal and image-relative reference frames. More importantly, a perception-computation decomposition exposes a key bottleneck: MLLMs can form capable spatial representations, yet fall short in the spatial transformations required to reason reliably across viewpoint changes.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了多模态语言模型中编码物体空间坐标的线性子空间S-Space，并揭示了其作为内部空间工作区的功能及空间推理失败的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型展现出有前景的空间推理能力，但支持这些能力的内部机制仍不清楚，需要深入理解以诊断和改进空间推理。
AI.method: 通过区分空间答案分数相对于物体token激活来识别S-Space子空间，利用因果干预验证其功能，并通过感知-计算分解分析空间推理失败的原因。
AI.result: 发现S-Space在非空间问题下仍可读且为内在表示；感知将位置编码入S-Space，内部推理变换它以支持视点变化；因果干预可改变空间判断而保持非空间响应；S-Space能为未见实体和观察者分配位置并连接物理方向与语言含义。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs能形成有效的空间表示，但在跨视点变化的空间变换方面存在关键瓶颈；S-Space可作为诊断工具揭示参考帧耦合问题，为未来改进空间推理能力指明方向。

title: Monarch-MoE: Structured Experts for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Learning new tasks in multimodal continual instruction tuning can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired knowledge. Although multi-expert LoRA distributes learning across experts, updates to a dense low-rank expert can still affect many output features. We introduce Monarch-MoE, which replaces the dense factors in LoRA experts with block-diagonal factors connected by a fixed permutation. This structure provides blockwise gradient isolation: individual block-pair updates affect only one output block, while connections between all input and output blocks are maintained. To make these compact experts practical on memory-limited hardware, we combine batched computation, fused forward operators, and an optimized backward pass. Across three continual-learning methods evaluated on MLLM-DCL and UCIT with LLaVA-1.5-7B, Monarch-MoE improves first-task retention while reducing adapter parameters by approximately 75% and 50%, respectively. In the main comparison, first-task forgetting is as low as 0.52 percentage points on MLLM-DCL and 0.10 on UCIT, with method-dependent trade-offs in final performance. Our implementation supports fine-tuning and inference on a single 24 GB RTX 4090, with lower measured memory use and competitive runtime in the evaluated settings. Together, these algorithmic and systems improvements make structured experts a practical option for continual adaptation on memory-limited hardware.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了Monarch-MoE，通过块对角因子替代LoRA中的稠密因子来实现分块梯度隔离，在减少参数和内存消耗的同时，有效缓解了多模态持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 解决多模态持续指令微调中多专家LoRA因稠密低秩专家更新引发灾难性遗忘的问题，并旨在使结构化专家在内存受限的硬件上具备实用性。
AI.method: 引入Monarch-MoE，用通过固定置换连接的块对角因子替代LoRA专家中的稠密因子，实现分块梯度隔离；同时结合批处理计算、融合前向算子和优化的反向传播以降低内存占用。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上的评估显示，该方法分别减少了约75%和50%的适配器参数，首任务遗忘率低至0.52（MLLM-DCL）和0.10个百分点（UCIT），支持在单张24GB RTX 4090上运行，具有更低的内存使用率和具竞争力的运行时间。
AI.conclusion: 算法与系统层面的改进使得结构化专家成为在内存受限硬件上进行持续适应的实用选项，有效平衡了参数效率、内存开销与抗遗忘能力。

title: AdaC-GRPO: Towards Mastering Long-Horizon Visual Sudoku Puzzles via Adaptive Curriculum Learning
summary: While reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models, its efficacy in long-horizon multimodal tasks remains underexplored. Visual Sudoku puzzles pose a representative challenge, requiring multi-step deductive reasoning over both local constraints and global dependency chains. To this end, we introduce FG-Sudoku, a fine-grained benchmark categorized by grid size and required deductive steps. Evaluations reveal that frontier MLLMs fail on complex long-range dependencies (e.g., 9*9 puzzles). During post-training, this near-zero success rate causes severe reward sparsity, halting standard RLVR. We propose Adaptive Curriculum Group Relative Policy Optimization (AdaC-GRPO) to overcome this. Unlike rigid or prior-based schedules, AdaC-GRPO dynamically constructs training batches by tracking the model's "Zone of Proximal Development" via online rollout accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that AdaC-GRPO enables Qwen2.5-VL-7B to approach the performance of Gemini-2.5-Flash while bridging 62.2% of the overall accuracy gap to Gemini-2.5-Pro, with its generalizability further validated across InternVL-3.5 and Qwen3-VL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了自适应课程强化学习方法AdaC-GRPO，以克服多模态大模型在复杂视觉数独任务中由于奖励稀疏导致的训练停滞问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管RLVR提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但在长周期多模态任务（如视觉数独）中，前沿模型成功率几乎为零，导致严重的奖励稀疏，阻碍了标准的RLVR训练。
AI.method: 提出了细粒度视觉数独基准FG-Sudoku，并引入了AdaC-GRPO（自适应课程组相对策略优化），通过在线rollout准确率追踪模型的“最近发展区”来动态构建训练批次。
AI.result: AdaC-GRPO使Qwen2.5-VL-7B接近Gemini-2.5-Flash的性能，并弥合了与Gemini-2.5-Pro之间62.2%的整体准确率差距，且在InternVL-3.5和Qwen3-VL上验证了泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应课程方法能有效克服多模态推理中的奖励稀疏性，显著提升中小型模型的推理能力至接近前沿水平，并具有良好的跨模型泛化能力。

title: From Glance to Focus: Mitigating Recognition Laziness in MLLMs for Fine-Grained Recognition
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) generally fall short of expectations in Fine-Grained Visual Recognition (FGVR), although they exhibit promising FGVR foundations, i.e., visual perception and broad category knowledge. Most existing studies seek to remedy this deficiency by adopting domain-specific post-training, at the risk of compromising generalization to unseen domains. Different from these efforts, in this paper, we revisit the FGVR mechanism underlying MLLMs from both the empirical and theoretical perspectives and uncover an inference-time phenomenon termed FGVR Laziness. In brief, FGVR Laziness refers to the insufficient association between visual cues and category concepts under certain candidate category lists and recognition guidance, leaving the FGVR foundations of MLLMs largely under-utilized. To mitigate FGVR Laziness, we propose Laziness-resIstant Visual rEcognition (LIVE), a training-free framework which jointly refines candidate lists and recognition guidance to elicit the latent FGVR capability of MLLMs. Specifically, LIVE first performs query-adaptive candidate inference to derive a compact yet reliable candidate list. Meanwhile, LIVE constructs category-specific FGVR skills by mining the intra-category characteristics and inter-category differences. Finally, LIVE selectively invokes detailed skill guidance according to recognition uncertainty and category confusion, shifting MLLM-based FGVR from a cursory glance to a focus on associating discriminative visual cues with category concepts. Extensive experiments on 13 benchmarks against 24 state-of-the-art methods spanning fine-grained category recognition, action recognition, and general category recognition, verify the effectiveness and generalizability of LIVE across different MLLM backbones. The code will be released upon acceptance.
comment: 21 pages, 18 figures, 5 tables. Includes supplementary material

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的框架LIVE，通过缓解多模态大语言模型推理时的“FGVR惰性”现象，有效提升其细粒度视觉识别能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在细粒度视觉识别（FGVR）上表现不佳，现有基于特定领域后训练的方法会损害模型在未见领域的泛化能力，因此需要一种不依赖领域特定训练的新方法来激发MLLMs潜在的FGVR能力。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的LIVE框架，通过联合优化候选列表和识别指导来缓解“FGVR惰性”。具体包括：进行查询自适应的候选推理以生成紧凑可靠的候选列表；通过挖掘类内特征和类间差异构建特定类别的FGVR技能；并根据识别不确定性和类别混淆选择性调用详细技能指导。
AI.result: 在涵盖细粒度类别识别、动作识别和通用类别识别的13个基准测试中，LIVE方法相较于24种最先进方法表现出有效性和泛化性，且兼容不同的MLLM骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: MLLM在FGVR上的不足可通过无需训练的推理时干预（缓解FGVR惰性）来有效解决，这为提升大模型视觉识别能力提供了新的通用且不损失泛化性的范式。

title: Measurable Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting with Joint Region and Depth Supervision for Interactive Building Inspection
summary: Image-based 3D reconstruction provides a scalable representation for building inspection and maintenance. However, photorealistic reconstruction alone does not fully provide the geometric measurability, semantic structure, and interactive information access required for engineering applications. This study proposes a measurable semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework with region and depth supervision for interactive building inspection from multi-view imagery. Mask-based region supervision suppresses irrelevant backgrounds and focuses optimization on target regions. Point-wise depth supervision guides Gaussian centers toward physical surfaces using reference geometry derived from multi-view stereo (MVS) point clouds, providing geometric anchors for measuring physical dimensions and areas. A semantic Gaussian field associates learnable class features with individual Gaussian primitives, enabling semantic rendering and component-level inspection. These capabilities are operationalized through AEC-SplatTwin, an interactive building inspection platform supporting real-time visualization, semantic analysis, quantitative measurement, and multimodal large language model (MLLM)-assisted interaction. On the synthetic UAV-inspection QuakeCity and smartphone-captured HKUPB datasets, the framework reduces Gaussian-center depth MAE by 58.1% and 86.8%, while its semantic field achieves mIoU values of 0.8529 and 0.8642. On HKUPB, the mean relative errors for height, width, and area measurements are 0.33%, 1.07%, and 0.60%. These results show that the proposed framework extends 3DGS beyond visual reconstruction into a measurable, semantically structured, and interactive engineering representation for building inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可测量的语义3D高斯泼射框架，通过区域掩膜监督和深度监督，将3DGS从纯视觉重建扩展为具备几何可测性、语义结构和交互能力的建筑检测工程表示。
AI.motivation: 基于图像的3D重建在建筑检测中虽有可扩展性，但单纯的光度真实感重建无法提供工程应用所需的几何可测性、语义结构和交互式信息访问能力。
AI.method: 提出可测量语义3DGS框架，核心包括：（1）基于掩膜的区域监督，抑制无关背景并聚焦目标区域优化；（2）基于多视图立体（MVS）点云的逐点深度监督，引导高斯中心趋近物理表面，提供几何锚点用于尺寸和面积测量；（3）语义高斯场，将可学习类别特征与单个高斯基元关联，实现语义渲染和构件级检测；并集成至AEC-SplatTwin交互平台，支持实时可视化、语义分析、定量测量和多模态大语言模型（MLLM）辅助交互。
AI.result: 在合成UAV检测数据集QuakeCity和手机采集数据集HKUPB上，高斯中心深度MAE分别降低58.1%和86.8%，语义场mIoU分别达到0.8529和0.8642；在HKUPB上，高度、宽度和面积测量的平均相对误差分别为0.33%、1.07%和0.60%。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架成功将3DGS从视觉重建扩展为可测量、语义结构化且可交互的工程表示，为建筑检测提供了兼具几何精度、语义理解和交互式分析的综合解决方案。

title: Mind the Spatial Gap: A Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning and Constrained Spatial Editing
summary: Understanding and manipulating spatial relations is fundamental to AI systems that reason about physical environments and construct grounded world models. However, existing evaluations of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for spatial reasoning rely predominantly on static question-answering (QA) over small-scale or synthetic scenes, rarely probing whether models can modify spatial configurations while satisfying explicit geometric constraints. We introduce GeoSpatialBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate an escalating progression of spatial cognition, ranging from spatial relation understanding and geometric reasoning to constrained spatial editing. Grounded in real-world urban data across six geographically diverse cities, GeoSpatialBench evaluates a comprehensive taxonomy of 28 topological, directional, metric, and ordering relations across structured GeoJSON and map image modalities, with ground-truth references and constraints verified via GIS operations. Our empirical evaluation across frontier MLLMs uncovers a stark spatial gap: structured GeoJSON consistently outperforms map images, with multimodal combinations offering no reliable gain over GeoJSON alone, and while models show reasonable competence on qualitative topological and ordering, performance drops on quantitative metric relations. Crucially, editing performance on ordering relations declines relative to QA, and most failed edits violate at least one specified spatial constraint. These results highlight a gap between passively recognizing spatial relations and actively manipulating geometric configurations. GeoSpatialBench provides an open, rigorous diagnostic testbed to benchmark these spatial limitations, laying essential empirical groundwork for physically grounded world models and embodied spatial AI.
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Under Review at ICLR 2027

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GeoSpatialBench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在理解空间关系、几何推理及受限空间编辑方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型空间推理评估多依赖于小规模或合成场景的静态问答，未充分探究模型在满足几何约束时修改空间配置的能力。
AI.method: 引入基于真实城市数据的GeoSpatialBench基准，评估28种空间关系（拓扑、方向、度量、顺序），结合GeoJSON和地图图像模态，测试从空间认知到受限空间编辑的递进能力，并通过GIS操作验证约束。
AI.result: 实证评估显示结构化GeoJSON表现优于地图图像，多模态组合无显著提升；模型在定性关系上表现较好，但在定量关系上表现较差；空间编辑性能弱于问答，且多数失败编辑违反了空间约束。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了被动识别与主动操纵空间配置间的差距，为物理世界模型和具身AI提供了严谨的诊断平台和实证基础。

title: OmniCapBench: A Deep-Structured Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Audio-Visual Captioning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving toward continuous audio--visual reasoning, creating an urgent need for evaluations that expose their capability limits. Audio--visual captioning is an ideal diagnostic task, yet current benchmarks face a coupled trade-off: whole-caption scores provide coverage without localization, local probes provide localization without coverage, and unconstrained LLM judges introduce instability. We introduce OmniCapBench (Omni-Video Caption Benchmark), a benchmark that reframes audio--visual caption evaluation as a deep-structured diagnostic framework. OmniCapBench shifts the prediction target from free-form text to sets of atomic, verifiable evaluation units across three tracks: entity references, visual shots, and audio events, enabling reliable scoring with deterministic constraint checks and localized LLM-based semantic comparisons. With 786 densely annotated videos, OmniCapBench effectively distinguishes MLLM perception errors, including temporal grounding failures, identity drift, cross-modal misalignment, and hallucinated descriptions. Evaluating frontier MLLMs reveals strong local perception but weak long-horizon audio--visual reasoning, particularly in identity drift and cross-modal misalignment, providing a fine-grained roadmap for omnimodal development.
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code and benchmark can be found at https://01yzzyu.github.io/OmniCapBench/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OmniCapBench，一个通过原子化可验证评估单元来诊断多模态大语言模型音视频推理能力的基准测试框架。
AI.motivation: 当前音视频字幕评估基准面临耦合权衡问题：整体字幕评分提供覆盖度但缺乏定位能力，局部探针提供定位能力但缺乏覆盖度，无约束的LLM评判引入不稳定性，亟需能够暴露MLLM在连续音视频推理中能力极限的评估方法。
AI.method: OmniCapBench将音视频字幕评估重构为深度结构化诊断框架，将预测目标从自由文本转向原子化可验证评估单元集合，包含实体引用、视觉镜头和音频事件三个赛道，通过确定性约束检查和局部化LLM语义比较实现可靠评分。
AI.result: 基于786个密集标注视频，OmniCapBench有效区分了MLLM感知错误，包括时间定位失败、身份漂移、跨模态错位和幻觉描述；对前沿MLLM的评估显示其局部感知能力强但长时段音视频推理能力弱，尤其在身份漂移和跨模态错位方面表现不足。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为全模态发展提供了细粒度路线图，揭示了前沿MLLM在局部感知和长时段音视频推理能力之间的显著差距，为后续模型改进指明了方向。

title: WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文引入了用于视觉转换推理的训练源和基准WOVEN，证明了通过该数据源进行训练可以提升多模态大语言模型在多个外部基准上的表现，并提出了视觉世界模型训练的有效方案。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在空间、具身、物理和时间推理方面存在困难，且现有基准独立记录这些缺陷，无法进行跨场景、动作和推理操作的受控比较。本文旨在探究这些失败是否源于视觉转换推理的共同缺陷。
AI.method: 引入了名为WOVEN的视觉转换推理训练源和基准，包含按场景、动作和推理类型组织的36,076个示例。评估了38个前沿多模态大语言模型，并在多种规模下使用WOVEN训练模型。通过受控比较得出了一种视觉世界建模的训练配方，即根据推理操作而非动作、场景或领域来选择监督，并倾向于更大的视觉状态变化以增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 对38个前沿模型的评估发现其存在显著的系统性缺陷：即使最强模型也远低于人类水平，且该缺陷在不同模型家族中普遍存在并随规模增加而持续。在WOVEN上训练的模型展现出广泛的迁移能力，仅约2,000个样本的子集即可使26个外部基准中的22个提升多达27.3个百分点，且WOVEN数据可替代30-50%的任务专属训练数据并保持相当的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 视觉转换推理可作为多模态大语言模型中系统化视觉世界模型训练的可复用基础。

title: GeoReform: Reflective Formalization Evolution for Multimodal Geometry Problem Solving
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to identify and use geometric relations in diagrams. Recent methods address this challenge by converting geometric entities, relations, and constraints into explicit textual representations for the model to reason over. However, effective formalization is highly non-trivial: on Geometry3K, structure injection fixes 28 errors but introduces 13 new ones among 200 examples. Redundant relations can distract the model, while ambiguous references to diagram elements can lead it to apply constraints incorrectly. This suggests that the key challenge is not merely extracting more geometric facts, but organizing them into representations that support downstream reasoning. To fully exploit the power of formalization, we further propose GeoReform, a reflective formalization evolution framework that treats formalization as an optimizable policy rather than a fixed parser output. GeoReform executes the full reasoning pipeline, collects failed rollouts, diagnoses defects in the current representation, and mutates the policy to better select, ground, group, and present geometric entities, relations, constraints, and targets. On Geometry3K, GeoReform improves Qwen3VL-2B accuracy from 42.0\% to 56.0\%. Extensive experiments and analyses across geometry reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that effective formalization is crucial for improving multimodal geometry reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GeoReform框架，通过将几何形式化视为可优化策略并反思失败结果来改进表示，从而提升多模态大语言模型的几何推理能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在图表几何关系识别和推理上存在困难，现有将几何关系转化为文本形式的方法存在冗余和模糊引用问题，且固定解析器输出可能引入新错误。
AI.method: 提出GeoReform反思性形式化演化框架，将形式化视为可优化策略，通过执行完整推理流程、收集失败结果、诊断当前表示缺陷并修改策略，以更好地选择、定位、分组和呈现几何元素。
AI.result: 在Geometry3K数据集上，GeoReform将Qwen3VL-2B模型的准确率从42.0%提升至56.0%，并证明了有效的形式化对几何推理至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 有效的形式化对于提升多模态大语言模型的几何推理能力至关重要，通过反思和优化形式化策略可以显著改善模型表现。

title: Is In-Domain Training Enough for Fine-Grained Industrial Anomaly Understanding?
summary: A single multimodal large language model (MLLM) struggles to excel simultaneously at detection, localization, description, and reasoning in multimodal industrial anomaly understanding (MM-IAU). We show that in-domain training does not close this gap. On MMAD, a widely adopted MM-IAU benchmark, trained specialists reach at most 75.5% accuracy in defect localization, against 92.3% for human experts, and even detect anomalies less accurately than their untrained base model. Meanwhile, different MLLMs offer complementary strengths but share this weakness in fine-grained perception, so combining them alone cannot remove it. We therefore propose SiGMA, a spatially grounded multi-agent framework that divides labor between heterogeneous MLLM agents and a dedicated visual defect expert. A multimodal searcher supplies industrial knowledge and normal references, the defect expert turns query-reference comparison into calibrated anomaly evidence, and a label-free reliability controller weighs each source by task-wise competence and query-level evidence quality. SiGMA reaches 85.2% average accuracy on MMAD, 4.0% above the strongest trained specialist and Gemini-2.5-Pro and within 1.5% of human experts. Even with three agents of at most 9B parameters, it reaches 84.4%, and new MLLMs join without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SiGMA，一个空间基础的多智能体框架，通过异构MLLM智能体与专用视觉缺陷专家分工协作，有效提升多模态工业异常理解能力。
AI.motivation: 单一多模态大语言模型（MLLM）难以在多模态工业异常理解（MM-IAU）的各项任务中同时表现出色，且域内训练无法弥合这一差距；同时，不同MLLM虽有互补优势，但都存在细粒度感知薄弱的缺陷，单纯组合无法解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出SiGMA框架，将任务分配给异构MLLM智能体和专用视觉缺陷专家：多模态搜索器提供工业知识和正常参考；缺陷专家将查询-参考比较转化为校准的异常证据；无标签可靠性控制器根据任务能力和查询级证据质量对每个信息源进行加权。
AI.result: SiGMA在MMAD基准上达到85.2%的平均准确率，比最强的训练专家和Gemini-2.5-Pro高出4.0%，距离人类专家不到1.5%；即使仅使用三个不超过9B参数的智能体，也能达到84.4%的准确率，并且新MLLM无需重训即可加入。
AI.conclusion: SiGMA有效缩小了MLLM与人类专家在工业异常理解中的性能差距，证明了多智能体分工协作与专用缺陷专家结合的有效性，且具备良好的可扩展性。
